lines.en: label norikospring4:
{i}Later that day...in a room so quiet we could hear each other’s hearts beat.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那天晚些时候……在安静得能听见彼此心跳的房间里。{/i}

lines.en: scene norikobrother1
It didn’t take long for Noriko to find us a safehouse of sorts — just a quick conversation with the woman at the front desk who handed her a room key, no questions asked.
lines.zh: Noriko 没花多久就给我们找到了一个类似安全屋的地方——她只是跟前台的女人简短说了几句，对方就把房卡递给了她，一句多余的话都没问。

lines.en: It makes me a little jealous, if I’m being honest. How she can just use her role to get the things she wants and then hand them over to me like it’s no trouble at all.
lines.zh: 说实话，这让我有点嫉妒。她居然能这样利用自己的身份拿到想要的东西，然后像根本不算什么似的交到我手上。

lines.en: I probably {i}shouldn’t{/i} feel that way given the things I have taken when {i}I{/i} wore her shoes, but I do.
lines.zh: 想想{i}我{/i}当年穿着她那双鞋的时候所夺走的东西，我大概{i}不该{/i}有这种感觉。可我确实有。

lines.en: And I’d go as far as saying it brings back bad memories if all of my memories weren’t already somewhat tainted to begin with.
lines.zh: 要不是我所有的记忆从一开始就多少沾了污，我甚至会说这勾起了不好的回忆。

lines.en: Regardless, here we are — bathed in ambient silence disrupted only by conversations that, while nostalgic, feel more like informative briefings on my past self than anything else.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们此刻就在这儿——浸泡在周遭的静谧里，只有对话偶尔将它打破；而那些对话虽然怀旧，却更像是在给我做关于过去那个我的情报简报。

lines.en: We talk of days past and days yet to come.
lines.zh: 我们聊着过去的日子，也聊着尚未到来的日子。

lines.en: Noriko embellishes each anecdote with unimportant details that walk the fine line between just existing for imagery and existing to try and help me remember something.
lines.zh: Noriko 给每段轶事都添上些无关紧要的细节，那些细节微妙地游走于「纯粹为了画面感而存在」与「为了帮我记起什么而存在」之间。

lines.en: And it works. It works in both regards.
lines.zh: 而这很有效。两方面都有效。

lines.en: I {i}can{/i} remember more of the past now that the largest gaps in time have been filled in by those I’ve loved and either lost or am losing.
lines.zh: 现在我{i}能{/i}记起更多过去了，因为时间上最大的那些空缺，已经被我爱过的、以及已经失去或正在失去的人填上了。

lines.en: Yet those pivotal, formative memories that clog my hippocampus like red hair swallowed by the drain disrupt my train of thought when the roots they take sprawl out onto my one-track mind.
lines.zh: 然而那些关键而塑造性的记忆，像被下水道吞掉的红发一样堵住了我的海马体；当它们生出的根蔓延伸到我那条单行道般的思维上时，便会打断我的思路。

lines.en: In taking root, however, I can feel things start to fall into place.
lines.zh: 不过在生根的过程中，我能感觉到一切开始归位。

lines.en: I can feel them reaching out and strangling things I’ve subconsciously suppressed, integrating them once more into a network of thoughts and feelings reminiscent of how trees talk to one another.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到它们伸展开来，勒住那些被我下意识压抑的东西，把它们重新编织回一张思想与情感的网络里，就像树木彼此交谈那样。

lines.en: So sit in my shade and listen to the sounds of a nearby station calling out where we are or where we’re headed.
lines.zh: 那么，就坐在我的树荫下吧，听听附近车站报出站名的声音，听它喊出我们在哪儿、或我们要去哪儿。

lines.en: There’s only a stop or two left after this one.
lines.zh: 这一站之后，只剩下一两站了。

lines.en: And if you miss your train, you might have to spend the night here.
lines.zh: 而如果你错过了你的那班车，你可能就得在这里过夜了。

lines.en: : Nostalgic, isn’t it? Sitting next to one another in a dimly lit room — hiding from Nee-chan while we talk about whatever crosses our minds.
lines.zh: : 挺怀旧的吧？在光线昏暗的房间里并肩坐着——一边躲着姐，一边聊着脑子里冒出来的任何东西。

lines.en: : If I didn’t know any better, I’d think you might be about to tutor me.
lines.zh: : 要不是我清楚得很，我都要以为你正准备给我补习了。

lines.en: : Frankly speaking, I don’t think there’s much left I can teach you at this point.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我觉得到了这一步，我已经没什么能教你的了。

lines.en: : Oh? Is {i}that{/i} why you gave up on teaching? Just...ran out of relevant information? Assuming of course that you didn’t run out the {i}first{/i} time you left me to fend for myself.
lines.zh: : 哦？所以你才放弃了教书？就只是……没相关的知识可讲了？当然，前提是你能教的东西不是在你{i}第一次{/i}丢下我自生自灭时就已经用完了。

lines.en: : {i}Two{/i} times now you have put my education at risk, Sensei. Two times now, you have pawned me off on someone else and just hoped I’d be able to figure things out on my own.
lines.zh: : 已经有{i}两次{/i}了，老师，你把我的教育置于险境。已经有两次，你把我转手丢给别人，然后只指望我自己能想明白。

lines.en: : Three if you want to count my initial departure. But I don’t think I was tutoring you yet back when I ran away from Niki.
lines.zh: : 要是算上我最初的离开，那就是三次。不过我从 Niki 身边逃走的时候，我大概还没开始给你补习。

lines.en: : That’s why I excluded it. It’s important to mention that you didn’t {i}just{/i} run away from Niki, though. You ran away from all of us.
lines.zh: : 所以我没把它算进去。不过有一点得说清楚——你当时不{i}只是{/i}从 Niki 身边逃走。你是从我们所有人身边逃走的。

lines.en: : My mom still asks about you all the time. It’s always, “Where’s my son? Where’s Akira? When’s Akira coming to visit?” every time I help out at the restaurant or drop by to say hello.
lines.zh: : 我妈到现在还老问起你。每次我去餐馆帮忙，或者顺路去打个招呼，她总是问：「我儿子呢？Akira 在哪儿？Akira 什么时候来看我？」

lines.en: scene norikobrother2
: I’m surprised she still cares at all after everything I put you guys through.
lines.zh: : 在我让你们经历了那么多之后，她竟然还在乎，我挺意外的。

lines.en: : {i}I’m{/i} not. She probably understood what you were going through better than either of {i}us{/i} back then. We were just confused and betrayed.
lines.zh: : 我不意外。她当年大概比{i}我们{/i}任何一个人都更理解你在经历什么。我们只是困惑，觉得被背叛了。

lines.en: : But we get it {i}now.{/i} And we don’t blame you for it, Onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 但{i}现在{/i}我们懂了。而我们不会为此责怪你，Onii-chan。

lines.en: : Niki still blames me for it. She’ll never let me live that down.
lines.zh: : Niki 到现在还在为此责怪我。她永远都不会让我翻篇的。

lines.en: : Sure. But Nee-chan only blames you on the surface. Deep down, she understands. That’s why she still loves you so much when, realistically, she could bag any boy {i}or{/i} girl in this city.
lines.zh: : 当然。可姐的责怪只是表面的。在心底，她是理解的。所以她才依然那么爱你——说实话，这座城里任何一个男孩女孩她都能手到擒来。

lines.en: scene norikobrother3
: That said, I can’t help but feel a {i}little{/i} angry that you keep letting me wander off on my own instead of continuing to cultivate my mind in ways only an older brother could.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，我还是忍不住{i}有点{/i}生气——你总是放任我一个人乱走，却不肯继续以只有哥哥才能做到的方式来耕耘我的头脑。

lines.en: : By filling it with worry and doubt and any other negative emotion you’d be burdened by receiving from me?
lines.zh: : 用担忧、怀疑，以及任何你从我这儿承受了就会成为负担的负面情绪去填满它？

lines.en: scene norikobrother4
: You always say that, but you’ve been my teacher twice now and have never filled me with worry or doubt either time.
lines.zh: : 你每次都这么说，可你当过我两次老师，两次都没有让我心里充满担忧或怀疑。

lines.en: scene norikobrother5
: At least until you started messing around with Maya. I will concede that I may have been worried {i}then.{/i}
lines.zh: : 至少在你开始和 Maya 乱搞之前是这样。{i}那一次{/i}我承认，我可能确实担心过。

lines.en: : But back then, it was mostly just worries about how you were starting to favor her over me. And {i}not{/i} so much worrying about what I {i}should{/i} have been worrying about.
lines.zh: : 但那时候，我担心的多半只是你开始偏心她、不再偏爱我。而{i}不是{/i}在担心我{i}本该{/i}担心的那件事。

lines.en: : Which was...
lines.zh: : 那件事是……

lines.en: scene norikobrother6
: How the {i}hell{/i} you were managing to fit it inside of that little girl.
lines.zh: : 你{i}到底{/i}是怎么把那玩意儿塞进那个小女孩里面的。

lines.en: scene norikobrother7
: That was...more vulgar and direct than I expected to hear. But yes. That’s exactly what you should have been worried about. But you weren’t.
lines.zh: : 这话说得……比我预想的还要粗俗直接。不过没错。那正是你本该担心的事。可你没有。

lines.en: : So you subjected her to a life of wanting nothing but {i}me{/i} and I’m sure I don’t need to inform you how terrible {i}that{/i} is.
lines.zh: : 于是你让她就此过上了除了{i}我{/i}什么都不想要的一生，而我相信我不需要告诉你{i}那{/i}有多糟糕。

lines.en: : You sure don’t...
lines.zh: : 你确实不需要……

lines.en: : Do you regret it, though? Doing those things with Maya? Tutoring? All of it? Is there not a single bright spot to be found in any of those years?
lines.zh: : 不过你后悔吗？和 Maya 做那些事？补习？所有这些？在那几年里，难道连一处亮点都找不到吗？

lines.en: scene norikobrother8
: Sure there is. I have you, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 当然有。我有你啊，不是吗？

lines.en: : Heheh~ Correct answer, Onii-chan! You’ve learned well from today’s marathon of sibling love. The time has clearly come for me to begin tutoring you instead.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~回答正确，Onii-chan！今天这场兄妹之爱的马拉松，你学得很不错。显然，现在是时候换我来给你补习了。

lines.en: scene norikobrother9
: It’s been a good day...yeah.
lines.zh: : 今天是很好的一天……是啊。

lines.en: : Mm...it must be if it can do...whatever {i}that{/i} is to your face.
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果它能对你的脸做出……{i}那个{/i}什么的话，那一定是个好日子。

lines.en: : I think kids these days are calling it a “smile,” but you’d know more about that than me.
lines.zh: : 我想现在的年轻人管那个叫「微笑」，不过这种事你懂得比我多。

lines.en: scene norikobrother10
: I don’t know, Onii-chan. You’re pretty clearly the one more {i}experienced{/i} with kids between the two of us.
lines.zh: : 那可不好说，Onii-chan。我们俩之间，跟小孩打交道的经验更{i}丰富{/i}的显然是你。

lines.en: : Okay. Smile gone. And remind me to never try to do that in front of you again.
lines.zh: : 好了。笑没了。还有，提醒我以后永远别再试着在你面前做那种事。

lines.en: scene norikobrother11
: Now {i}why{/i} would I do that? It’s a little sister’s sole mission in life to make her big brother smile, isn’t it? Otherwise, he won’t want to protect her from potential evil suitors.
lines.zh: : 我{i}为什么{/i}要那么做？让哥哥笑出来，不就是妹妹此生唯一的任务吗？不然他就不想保护她、不让那些居心不良的追求者靠近了。

lines.en: : I’m too nice to face all those evil suitors on my own, Onii-chan. I need you to reject them for me. And beat them up if they try to get too handsy.
lines.zh: : 我太善良了，没法一个人面对那些居心不良的追求者，Onii-chan。我需要你替我拒绝他们。要是他们敢动手动脚，你就把他们揍一顿。

lines.en: : Just maybe not {i}too{/i} badly or you’ll wind up having to spend your days with Uta’s brother instead of an idol, a bunch of MILFs, and an entire high school.
lines.zh: : 只是别打得{i}太{/i}狠，不然你就得当个跟 Uta 的哥哥一起过日子的人了，而不是跟一个偶像、一堆熟女、还有一整个高中。

lines.en: : Is it just me, or is that bright spot I referenced earlier starting to get a little dim?
lines.zh: : 是我多心，还是我刚才提到的那个亮点开始变暗了？

lines.en: scene norikobrother12
: Hey! I take great pride in being your bright spot! And if anything, you’re super lucky I’m still glowing after all these years!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我可是以当你的亮点为荣的！要说别的，你该庆幸这么多年来我居然还在发光！

lines.en: : If anything, you’re lucky it wasn’t {i}you{/i} in Maya’s shoes back then. Because I imagine our relationship now would be a lot different if you were.
lines.zh: : 要说别的，{i}你{/i}该庆幸当初站在 Maya 那个位置上的不是你。因为如果是你，我想我们现在的关系会大不一样。

lines.en: scene norikobrother13
: You mean like if you touched {i}me{/i} and stuff instead?
lines.zh: : 你是说，如果是换成你碰{i}我{/i}之类的？

lines.en: : Yes. But not if you’re going to say something like “I wish you did” or any of those other things I know you only say to try and appeal to me when you’re clearly better than that.
lines.zh: : 是的。但如果你打算说「真希望你当初那么做了」之类的，那就别说了——我知道那些话你只是为了讨好我才说的，而你明明远比那更好。

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} better than that. And I’m {i}glad{/i} it wasn’t me in Maya’s shoes back then because I don’t think I’d be able to look at you the same way I do today.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}比那更好。而且我很{i}高兴{/i}当初站在 Maya 那个位置上的不是我，因为那样的话，我想我就没法用今天这样的眼光看你了。

lines.en: : Mistakes are harder to forgive when they happen to you.
lines.zh: : 当错误发生在自己身上时，就更难原谅。

lines.en: : They’re {i}still{/i} happening, though. And they {i}have{/i} happened to you. Do I need to remind you of the age gap here? Or have you just forgotten about that like everyone else?
lines.zh: : 可它们{i}还{/i}在发生。而且它们也发生在你身上了。需要我提醒你一下这里的年龄差吗？还是说你也跟其他人一样，把这件事给忘了？

lines.en: : I actually think it’s more of a split between those who “forget” about it and those who lean into it because they think it’s hot.
lines.zh: : 我倒觉得，这更像是分成了两派——一派「忘了」这回事，另一派则因为觉得这很性感而干脆顺势而为。

lines.en: : You forgive me either way, though. And that’s because {i}you’re{/i} caught in the web as well.
lines.zh: : 不过不管怎样，你都原谅了我。而那是因为{i}你{/i}也困在同一张网里。

lines.en: : I do forgive you and I {i}am{/i} caught in the web, yes. But that has nothing to do with {i}why{/i} I forgive you.
lines.zh: : 我确实原谅了你，我也{i}确实{/i}困在那张网里。但这跟我{i}为什么{/i}原谅你毫无关系。

lines.en: : Then...why? What else would just let you keep overlooking {i}mistakes{/i} like the ones I’ve made? Because you’re not {i}stupid.{/i} And I know you’re impulsive, but-
lines.zh: : 那……为什么？还有什么别的理由，能让你一直对像我犯下的那些{i}错误{/i}视而不见？你又不{i}傻{/i}。我知道你是冲动，可是——

lines.en: : Because we’re family, silly.
lines.zh: : 因为我们是一家人呀，傻瓜。

lines.en: scene norikobrother14
: And no matter what happens, you’ll always be my brother first and a {i}man{/i} second.
lines.zh: : 而且无论发生什么，你永远先是哥哥，其次才是个{i}男人{/i}。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : Why...do you still so relentlessly pursue me then?
lines.zh: : 那为什么……你还是这么执着地追着我不放？

lines.en: : One does not {i}choose{/i} to be a brocon. One is simply born that way.
lines.zh: : 兄控不是自己{i}选{/i}的。人生来便是如此。

lines.en: scene norikobrother15
: Noriko-
lines.zh: : Noriko——

lines.en: : Don’t “Noriko” me. I’ve been nothing but gleefully platonic all day long and I’m not about to get scolded for a bunch of stuff I’ve said or done in the past.
lines.zh: : 别「Noriko」我。我一整天都快快乐乐地保持着柏拉图式，我可不想为了一些我过去说过做过的事挨训。

lines.en: : If you want me to be your sister and nothing else, that’s what I’ll be. And I’ll be happy doing it because, again, I love you like you share my blood.
lines.zh: : 如果你要我只当你的妹妹、别的什么都不是，那我就当。而且我会当得很开心，因为再说一次，我爱你，就像你和我流着一样的血。

lines.en: : And that’s probably not the most appropriate or...normal way to word that, but it’s the truth. {i}You{/i} are my brother.
lines.zh: : 这大概不是最得体、或者说最「正常」的说法，可这是事实。{i}你{/i}就是我的哥哥。

lines.en: : And every single time I get to look at you and say “Onii-chan,” it’s like there’s a surge of energy coursing through me that makes me feel like I can do anything.
lines.zh: : 而每一次我能看着你、喊出「Onii-chan」的时候，就好像有一股能量涌遍全身，让我觉得自己什么都做得到。

lines.en: : And with you by my side, I think I {i}can.{/i} That’s why I’m still in the background of my fantasies. That’s why I can forgive you for all the “mistakes” you make with my friends.
lines.zh: : 而有你在我身边，我想我{i}真的{/i}做得到。那就是为什么在我的幻想里，我总把自己放在背景里。那就是为什么我能原谅你和我的朋友们犯下的所有「错误」。

lines.en: scene norikobrother16
: I love you in ways that only a younger sibling {i}could.{/i} And you don’t need to understand it, but-
lines.zh: : 我爱你，用的是只有弟弟妹妹{i}才能{/i}做到的方式。你不需要理解，可是——

lines.en: : Good. Because I {i}don’t{/i} understand it.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为我确实{i}不{/i}理解。

lines.en: scene norikobrother17
: And it’s not...{i}just{/i} because you also want to fuck me sometimes.
lines.zh: : 而且它不{i}只是{/i}……因为你有的时候也想干我。

lines.en: : It’s because I inherently don’t understand why that...familial connection alone would bring you {i}joy{/i} when it did nothing but fucking...{i}terrorize{/i} me for my entire life.
lines.zh: : 而是因为我天生就无法理解，为什么那种……血缘般的羁绊本身就能带给你{i}快乐{/i}，而它在我这一生里，除了他妈的……{i}恐吓{/i}我之外，什么都没干过。

lines.en: scene norikobrother18
: Sorry, I...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我……

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : You mention your brother so rarely, I...forgot you even {i}had{/i} one.
lines.zh: : 你极少提起你哥哥，我……都快忘了你{i}还{/i}有个哥哥。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...
: {i}That’s{/i} why I have a hard time understanding the way you feel about me. And how you can be so happy to have something {i}I{/i} was so...
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}就是为什么我很难理解你对我的感觉。也很难理解，你怎么能如此开心地拥有一样{i}我{/i}当初那么……的东西。

lines.en: : So...{i}afraid{/i} of.
lines.zh: : 那么……{i}害怕{/i}的东西。

lines.en: : Afraid?...
: {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: scene norikobrother19
: He had everything I didn’t. He was everything I’m not.
lines.zh: : 他拥有我没有的一切。他是我不成的一切。

lines.en: : And He lorded it over me as if He was God himself.
lines.zh: : 而他像个神明一样，把这些当作权柄压在我头上。

lines.en: : He blamed me for what happened to my father. He blamed me for what happened to my mother. And I {i}believed{/i} Him.
lines.zh: : 他把父亲身上发生的事怪在我头上。他把母亲身上发生的事怪在我头上。而我{i}相信{/i}了他。

lines.en: : I {i}believed{/i} Him because I saw what He was and I saw what {i}I{/i} was and it was...night and fucking day, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 我{i}相信{/i}他，是因为我看到他是什么样的，也看到{i}我{/i}是什么样的，而那简直是……黑夜与白昼之别，Noriko。

lines.en: : I was weak. He was a man. I was small. He was this...fucking colossus. I can’t even...I don’t...there are no words to explain how different we were.
lines.zh: : 我软弱。他是个男人。我渺小。他是……一尊他妈的巨像。我甚至……我……没有任何语言能解释我们有多不一样。

lines.en: : He’d lock me in the closet for days at a time. Tear up my clothes. Piss on me. Make me act and...bark like a fucking dog just so I could {i}eat.{/i}
lines.zh: : 他会把我把我锁进衣柜，一锁就是好几天。撕烂我的衣服。往我身上撒尿。逼我学狗……学他妈的狗叫，只为了让我有口饭{i}吃{/i}。

lines.en: : But it was less like being a pet and more just...something to step on. And kick...and beat...and just genuinely fucking terrorize and abuse...
lines.zh: : 可那与其说是当宠物，不如说只是……一个可以踩的东西。可以踢……可以打……可以真他妈的恐吓和虐待的东西……

lines.en: : And I didn’t have anyone to protect me from that.
lines.zh: : 而没有任何人保护我，让我躲开那些。

lines.en: : At least...not at first.
lines.zh: : 至少……一开始没有。

lines.en: scene norikobrother20
: But then He met someone.
lines.zh: : 但后来他遇到了一个人。

lines.en: : A girl.
lines.zh: : 一个女孩。

lines.en: : With beautiful red hair and a soft, delicate voice — who dressed like a character from an old movie and wrote poetry that could move even the most heartless of monsters.
lines.zh: : 她有一头漂亮的红发，嗓音轻柔纤细——穿得像老电影里的人物，写的诗连最冷血的怪物都能打动。

lines.en: : She didn’t know I existed at first. But one day, she must have heard me.
lines.zh: : 一开始她并不知道我的存在。但有一天，她一定听见了我的动静。

lines.en: : I can still see it...the glare of the sun when she pulled open the door of the closet. Him, towering over her, laughing like He’d forgotten I was in there.
lines.zh: : 我到现在都还能看见那个画面……她拉开衣柜门时，阳光刺眼。他居高临下地站在她身后，笑得像是根本忘了我还在里面。

lines.en: : She looked at me...and her eyes immediately doubled in size. But before I could pull the door shut, she...
lines.zh: : 她看着我……眼睛一下子瞪得溜圆。可我还没来得及把门关上，她就……

lines.en: : She turned around and slapped Him so hard that, for the first time in my life, I got to see {i}Him{/i} on the receiving end of physical pain.
lines.zh: : 她转过身，狠狠扇了{i}他{/i}一巴掌——有生以来第一次，我看到他成了承受肉体疼痛的那一方。

lines.en: : “How long has he been in there?!” she asked Him. And I can’t remember how He replied, but...
lines.zh: : 「他在这里面多久了？！」她问他。我不记得他是怎么回答的，可是……

lines.en: : The next thing I knew, she was pulling me out. And crying on {i}my{/i} behalf while I just...stood there. Sweaty. Covered in piss. Worried I’d get her dress dirty.
lines.zh: : 等我反应过来，她已经把我拉了出来。她替{i}我{/i}哭着，而我只是……站在那儿。满身是汗。浑身是尿。还担心自己会弄脏她的裙子。

lines.en: : That’s why I can’t stand when people call her a monster. Because she wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 那就是为什么我受不了别人叫她怪物。因为她不是。

lines.en: : She was the first person to ever show me there was more to life than what I had.
lines.zh: : 她是第一个让我知道，人生不只有我所拥有的那点东西的人。

lines.en: : I never slept in the closet again after that. From that point on it was just-
lines.zh: : 从那以后，我再也没在衣柜里睡过。从那时起，就只是——

lines.en: scene norikobrother21
: ...Wait, when did we start holding hands?
lines.zh: : ……等等，我们什么时候开始牵手的？

lines.en: : Akira...why?
lines.zh: : Akira……为什么？

lines.en: : Why haven’t you ever told me this?
lines.zh: : 为什么你从来没有告诉过我这些？

lines.en: scene norikobrother22
: I haven’t told {i}anyone.{/i} You’re the first.
lines.zh: : 我没告诉过{i}任何人{/i}。你是第一个。

lines.en: : But why did you wait so long?...Why did you keep that inside for so many years? Didn’t it hurt? {i}Doesn’t{/i} it hurt?
lines.zh: : 可你为什么等了这么久？……为什么把这件事在心里埋了这么多年？它不痛吗？难道现在{i}不{/i}痛吗？

lines.en: : I mean, He’s dead now. So I got the last laugh in the end.
lines.zh: : 我是说，他现在已经死了。所以到最后，笑到最后的人是我。

lines.en: scene norikobrother23
: What about Ami?...Does she know he put you through all of that? That girl was her mom, right? And she-
lines.zh: : 那 Ami 呢？……她知道他让你承受了这一切吗？那个女孩是她妈妈，对吧？而她——

lines.en: : No, and I’d prefer it if she didn’t. So please don’t say anything to her about it. I’m trusting you, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 不知道，而且我希望她别知道。所以请别对她说起这些。我信任你，Noriko。

lines.en: : Of course, Onii-chan. But-
lines.zh: : 当然，Onii-chan。可是——

lines.en: : If it’s okay, can we not make a big deal out of this right now? Because it’s starting to feel a lot like the time your {i}sister{/i} got me to stop repressing something and that really sucked.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，我们现在能不能别把这件事闹得那么大？因为它开始变得很像那次你{i}姐{/i}让我停止压抑某件事的情形，而那真的糟透了。

lines.en: : So Nee-chan...doesn’t know either?
lines.zh: : 那姐……也不知道？

lines.en: : Nope...just you.
lines.zh: : 不知道……只有你。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : You’ve never put me first before.
lines.zh: : 你从来没有把我放在第一位过。

lines.en: : Why now?
lines.zh: : 为什么是现在？

lines.en: : I just...didn’t like that whole “seeing you as more of a brother than a man” thing when both of those words cut pretty deeply in certain contexts. To me, at least.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不太喜欢那句「把你当成哥哥多过当成男人」，因为在某些语境下，这两个词都扎得挺深的。至少对我来说是这样。

lines.en: : Should I not call you my brother anymore then?
lines.zh: : 那我以后不该再叫你哥哥了吗？

lines.en: : You can call me whatever you want. It’s fine if it’s you.
lines.zh: : 你想叫我什么就叫什么。只要是你就好。

lines.en: : But I’d feel more comfortable knowing you just look at me as “me” rather than a {i}brother{/i} or a {i}man{/i} or...even a {i}teacher.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但要是我知道，你只是把我看成「我」，而不是{i}哥哥{/i}、{i}男人{/i}，或者……甚至是{i}老师{/i}，我会更自在。

lines.en: : I’m Akira. You’re Noriko. That’s it. That’s all it needs to be.
lines.zh: : 我是 Akira。你是 Noriko。就这些。只需要是这些。

lines.en: I’m not sure how long we stay like this for.
lines.zh: 我不确定我们这样待了多久。

lines.en: But I’m pretty sure of where it’ll go if we don’t break apart.
lines.zh: 但我很确定，如果我们不分开，接下来会走向哪里。

lines.en: scene norikobrother24
: Noriko, I...
lines.zh: : Noriko，我……

lines.en: : I don’t know if...we should really be...you know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我们是不是真的该……你知道的。

lines.en: : Know what? Say it.
lines.zh: : 知道什么？说出来。

lines.en: scene norikobrother25
: {i}Say it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}说出来。{/i}

lines.en: : What shouldn’t we do?
lines.zh: : 我们不该做什么？

lines.en: : What don’t you want to do with me?
lines.zh: : 你不想和我做什么？

lines.en: : And what happens if {i}I{/i} want to do it with you?
lines.zh: : 那如果{i}我{/i}想和你做呢？

lines.en: scene norikobrother26
: It was a mistake telling me to look at you as just “you” Akira.
lines.zh: : 让我把你看成单纯的「你」，是个错误，Akira。

lines.en: : When I do that, it suddenly becomes a lot harder to stop myself from acting out on certain things.
lines.zh: : 因为一旦我那么做，我就突然很难阻止自己去把某些事付诸行动了。

lines.en: : Sure. But what you’re feeling isn’t love or lust right now...it’s pity. You don’t know how to handle being the only person who knows something about me. So your mind is going haywire and-
lines.zh: : 当然。可你现在感受到的并不是爱，也不是欲望……是怜悯。你不知道该怎么面对「你是唯一知道我某件事的人」这件事。所以你的脑子乱成一团，而且——

lines.en: : Don’t tell me what’s going on in {i}my{/i} mind. Not when you can’t even figure out what’s going on with yours.
lines.zh: : 别告诉我{i}我{/i}脑子里在想什么。你自己脑子里的东西都还没弄清楚呢。

lines.en: : Because I can forgive you for keeping all of this inside to protect yourself. And I can forgive you for not {i}wanting{/i} to tell anyone now because it’s hard or it hurts or it’s embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 因为我可以原谅你为了自我保护，把这一切都藏在心里。我也可以原谅你现在不{i}想{/i}告诉任何人，因为那很艰难、很痛、或者很丢脸。

lines.en: : Fuck, I can forgive you for almost {i}anything{/i} because of who you are and what we {i}have.{/i}
lines.zh: : 操，看在你这个人、以及我们之间所{i}拥有{/i}的东西的份上，我几乎可以原谅你{i}任何事{/i}。

lines.en: : But if you hand me a piece of yourself that I get to keep and {i}I{/i} don’t get to give any part of myself to you?...
lines.zh: : 可如果你交给我一块属于你的东西，让{i}我{/i}可以留着，而我却不能把任何一部分的自己交给你？……

lines.en: : How is that fair?
lines.zh: : 这算哪门子公平？

lines.en: : How is {i}any{/i} of this fair?
lines.zh: : 这一切到底有{i}哪一点{/i}公平？

lines.en: : And how can you look at me — {i}Noriko{/i} — while I look at you as Akira and not find yourself drowning in a lifetime worth of wanting?
lines.zh: : 而当你看着我——{i}Noriko{/i}——而我以 Akira 的身份看着你的时候，你怎么能不发现自己正淹没在一辈子分量的渴望里？

lines.en: : Because you might be perturbed by the thought that I would see you as a {i}man...{/i}but I {i}want{/i} you to see me as a woman.
lines.zh: : 因为你也许会因为我可能把你看成一个{i}男人{/i}而感到不安……可我{i}要{/i}你把我看作一个女人。

lines.en: : And I want you to love me the way {i}you{/i} love. Because if you don’t now, I might never believe you.
lines.zh: : 我要你用{i}你{/i}爱人的方式爱我。因为如果你现在不爱，我可能永远都不会再相信你了。

lines.en: : This is exactly how it ended last time and now your sister lives in my house...
lines.zh: : 上一次就是这样结束的，而如今你姐姐住在我家里……

lines.en: : I am {i}not{/i} my sister.
lines.zh: : 我{i}不是{/i}我姐姐。

lines.en: : I am my {i}own{/i} person who feels and thinks and wants and loves. And I am {i}tired{/i} of pushing all of that aside in favor of other people.
lines.zh: : 我是{i}我自己{/i}，一个会感受、会思考、会渴望、会去爱的人。而我{i}厌倦{/i}了为了别人，把这些全都推到一边。

lines.en: : But I will not choose {i}for{/i} you. And if you decide that you want a sister and nothing else, all you need to do is stay silent in response to the following haiku.
lines.zh: : 但我不会{i}替{/i}你做选择。如果你认定你想要的只是一个妹妹、别的什么都不要，那你只需要在听到下面这首俳句之后保持沉默。

lines.en: : A haiku? Now?
lines.zh: : 俳句？现在？

lines.en: : What’s wrong? You like poets, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你不是喜欢诗人吗？

lines.en: : I mean...that’s not {i}exactly{/i} true. It’s just that...it’s easier for me to understand someone’s feelings when they’re conveyed in a way that-
lines.zh: : 我是说……那也不{i}完全{/i}准确。只是……当别人的感情用某种方式表达出来时，我会更容易理解——

lines.en: : Then understand this, Akira.
lines.zh: : 那就理解这个吧，Akira。

lines.en: : If you take me here...
lines.zh: : 如果你在这里要了我……

lines.en: : You will have me forever.
lines.zh: : 你就会永远拥有我。

lines.en: : There is no escape.
lines.zh: : 无路可逃。

lines.en: scene norikobrother27
: That is fine by me.
lines.zh: : 我完全接受。

lines.en: scene norikobrother28
: I’m sick of running away.
lines.zh: : 我已经厌倦了逃跑。

lines.en: : You’ve suffered enough.
lines.zh: : 你已经受够苦了。

lines.en: : A haiku...
lines.zh: : 俳句……

lines.en: : It took me a second to think of one. Sorry for the suspense.
lines.zh: : 我想了一会儿才想出来。抱歉让你等得心悬。
: 那么……

lines.en: : Does this mean...
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着……

lines.en: scene norikobrother29
: It means you’re going to have to stop crying or I won’t be able to go through with this.
lines.zh: : 这意味着你得先停止哭泣，否则我没法继续下去。

lines.en: : I don’t think I can. All the confidence I had a second ago has now been replaced by nerves. This feels too real. Like I’m...dreaming or something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我停不下来。刚才那点自信，现在全被紧张取代了。这感觉太真实了。就像我在……做梦还是什么的。

lines.en: : Do your dreams {i}normally{/i} begin with me trauma dumping all over you?
lines.zh: : 你的梦{i}一般{/i}都是以我把创伤一股脑倒在你身上开头的吗？

lines.en: : No. But they normally {i}end{/i} with you on top of me.
lines.zh: : 不是。但一般都是以你压在我身上{i}结束{/i}的。

lines.en: : Then what do you say we make half of a dream come true tonight, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 那么，我们今晚就让半个梦成真吧，Noriko？

lines.en: : Mhm...
: You realize that by doing this, you’ll effectively be committing incest, right?
lines.zh: : 你明白这样做，实际上就等于是在乱伦，对吧？

lines.en: : Mhm! Mhm...
: It’s okay if it’s you...Onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 只要是你就没关系……Onii-chan。

lines.en: scene norikobrother30
: Then stop looking so scared...I’ll take good care of you.
lines.zh: : 那就别一副那么害怕的样子……我会好好对你的。

lines.en: : I’m sure you will. {i}Very{/i} sure. Just...what if Ami is hiding in the closet or something? I still have PTSD from that.
lines.zh: : 我确信你会。{i}非常{/i}确信。只是……万一 Ami 也躲在衣柜里之类的怎么办？那件事我到现在还有创伤后应激障碍。

lines.en: : Then she takes after me in even more ways than I thought.
lines.zh: : 那她跟我相似的地方，比我想的还要多。

lines.en: : Not funny, Onii-chan. I don’t want this to set a precedent in which you start making self-deprecating trauma jokes around me from now on.
lines.zh: : 一点都不好笑，Onii-chan。我可不想从今往后开这个先例，让你在我身边拿自己的创伤开自嘲的玩笑。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t worry about that. I don’t think I’ll have much time for jokes at all between everything I want to do to you.
lines.zh: : 这个你不用担心。我想在我想对你做的所有事情之间，我根本没什么时间说笑话。

lines.en: : Oh god...I’m about to cum and we haven’t even started yet.
lines.zh: : 哦天啊……我都快去了，而我们甚至还没开始。

lines.en: : Yes we have...
lines.zh: : 不，我们已经开始了……

lines.en: scene black
: Aaah! Onii-chan! Or...A..Akira? What do I...uhh...how should I-
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！Onii-chan！还是……A……Akira？我该……呃……该怎么——

lines.en: : Let’s go with {i}Onii-chan{/i} today. You’re at your cutest when you’re being my little sister.
lines.zh: : 今天就叫 {i}Onii-chan{/i} 吧。你当我的小妹妹时最可爱。

lines.en: : Which is why I’m already like this.
lines.zh: : 所以我才已经变成这样了。

lines.en: : {i}Hah!{/i} Onii...chan!~ {i}Ah!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈啊{/i}！Onii……chan!~{i}啊{/i}!
